With high health and a powerful retaliation weapon with a massive area, Congregation is well suited for
runs. This makes it somewhat hard to die and obtain the Velvet Dodecahedron, but its usefulness in Divine Bloodline builds is dubious anyway.
If running Divine Bloodline, exceptionally consider not picking up

and other Cooldown reduction sources. This is because Screams from the Void and Forbidden Siren will only count as retaliatory damage if they actually retaliate. If Congregation is firing its weapons too often without being damaged, that may make it difficult for enemies to reach the Survivor and hamper max HP scaling.

Forbidden Siren will cause Congregation's character ability to activate more often by pulling enemies into the player; make sure to have a source of healing to allow you to 'reload' the ability, and avoid actually dying, as this will reduce your revive count and thus reduce its damage output.
